queries: City of Beaufort Metal Roofing Guidelines terne metal staff policy
excerpt: City of Beaufort HRB, Metal Roofing Guidelines (undated; re-read 2026-10-13): terne metal is historically significant and still found on many historic structures in the Historic District; needs cyclical maintenance and recoating; neglected areas rust and compromise watertightness. Longstanding policy of the City Staff Architect is to preserve as many historic terne metal roofs as possible; staff always ask for photo documentation of a terne roof requested to be removed; if it can be preserved staff recommend recoating; if not, an appropriate metal roof such as mechanical lock standing seam; staff do not support replacing terne with a significantly different material such as asphalt shingles. Snap lock not appropriate for historic, contributing structures (cannot be hand-folded).
